### Working with Your Morgan Stanley Financial Advisor

During times of volatility, remind yourself of the reasons you invested in the first place and the long-term goals you are working toward. It's crucial to stay grounded in the knowledge that markets have historically recovered over time and that a disciplined mindset — and the support and guidance of your Financial Advisor — can help you navigate these fluctuations with confidence. If you don’t need cash right away and have a well-researched, diversified portfolio, realize that downturns ultimately are temporary. The market may sometimes feel like it could go to zero, but market history shows that rebounds can return many portfolios to the black in just a few years. [...] Next
